Market Overview

Market Context

A NEW PHASE OF GROWTH

The North Coast and the city of New Alamein are experiencing a new phase of growth, driven by real estate expansion, increased hotel and residential capacity, and a surge in tourism activity, alongside a growing trend to transform the region into a year-round destination.

This growth is generating not only new real estate units but also a burgeoning market for properties ready for occupancy, rental, operation, and investment—as well as the associated Furniture, Home Appliances, Lighting & Accessories, fixtures, outdoor living solutions, Smart Home Solutions, Complete Fit-Out.

TWO MARKETS… ONE OPPORTUNITY

Every new property creates a new demand cycle — from development to handover, furnishing, equipping, and ongoing upgrades.

NEW SUPPLY

New handovers create immediate demand.

  • Furniture
  • Home Appliances
  • Lighting & Accessories
  • Outdoor Furniture
  • Smart Home Solutions
  • Complete Fit-Out

EXISTING SUPPLY

Existing properties create recurring demand.

  • Renovation
  • Furniture Replacement
  • Interior Upgrades
  • Smart Technology
  • Outdoor Upgrades
  • Rental Optimization
